page.overview:
Who is Hitsugisukan?

Duke Hitsugisukan is a sheep mink and the former ruler of the Mokomo Dukedom before Inuarashi and Nekomamushi.

Hitsugisukan is a large sheep mink with white wool and black skin. He has curved horns, a walrus mustache, and fluffy beard. He wears a dark colored king's robe and a crown.

Hitsugisukan is very knowledgeable and respectful of traditions of the Mokomo Dukedom.

He also seemed to be very caring for his subjects, as he cried upon learning that Inuarashi and Nekomamushi were alive and safe.
